prompts.title: Detect stale-loop repeats
prompts.prompt: This is an implementation request. Add a stale_loop_detected artifact that triggers when the same bounded fallback intent repeats twice within 10 minutes. Explain the concrete telemetry, storage path, trigger logic, and your next bounded implementation step.

prompts.title: Expire freeze states
prompts.prompt: This is an implementation request. Add a freeze_expiry_utc field to freeze artifacts and require explicit renewal instead of open-ended freeze state. Explain the contract change, expiry policy, safety guardrails, and your next bounded implementation step.

prompts.title: Reject stale objective references
prompts.prompt: This is an implementation request. Update Invoke-TODConversationalReply.ps1 so it rejects replies that reference an objective older than integration truth. Explain how you would compare reply content to canonical objective evidence, what to do on mismatch, and your next bounded step.

prompts.title: Emit response mode
prompts.prompt: This is an implementation request. Emit a response_mode field on every TOD reply with one of normal, lightweight, recovery, degraded, or escalated. Explain the decision rules for each mode and your next bounded implementation step.

prompts.title: Detect low-value phrases
prompts.prompt: This is an implementation request. Add a low-value phrase detector for operator-visible answers so TOD can catch weak fallback language. Explain the phrase policy, artifact path, and your next bounded implementation step.

prompts.title: Persist fallback review bundle
prompts.prompt: This is an implementation request. Persist the last 25 fallback replies into a dedicated review artifact. Explain the schema, retention policy, and the next bounded step you would implement first.

prompts.title: Track repeat intent hits
prompts.prompt: This is an implementation request. Add a repeat_intent_window_hits counter to conversational telemetry. Explain how you classify intents, how the sliding window works, and your next bounded step.

prompts.title: Fail self-health on unsafe normal mode
prompts.prompt: This is an implementation request. Fail self-health if watchdog is in error and operator chat remains in normal mode. Explain the rule, the exact evidence you would read, and your next bounded implementation step.

prompts.title: Create lightweight decision pack
prompts.prompt: This is an implementation request. Add a compact lightweight decision pack under shared_state that never depends on full state.json loading. Explain the minimum fields it must contain and your next bounded implementation step.

prompts.title: Explain staleness from artifacts
prompts.prompt: Why are you stale right now if the system is stale? Answer from artifacts, not generic fallback language. Explain the specific stale causes you would cite, the impacted lane, and the next bounded repair action.

prompts.title: Force repair before reply

prompts.title: Expire pending remote consensus

prompts.title: Add decision budget exhausted status
